name: CloseWorkbook
label: Close Excel Workbook
description: Closes the specified Excel workbook and optionally quits the Excel application.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook instance to be closed.

fields.name: ExcelApp
fields.label: Excel Application Instance
fields.description: The Excel Application instance to optionally quit after closing the workbook.

fields.name: SaveBeforeClose
fields.label: Save Before Closing
fields.description: Whether to save the workbook before closing.

fields.name: QuitExcelApp
fields.label: Quit Excel Application
fields.description: Whether to quit the Excel Application after closing the workbook.
